name: 28037 · Denver, NC
findings: ZIP 28037 (Denver) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28037 (Denver) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28037 (Denver) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 28037 (Denver) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 hobby and sports organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do hobby and sports organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list public events, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
